meta.title: Partner with PoStory
meta.description: You own the client, we handle content production and execution. Prepay per client, price however you like, and try it free on one real client first.

hero.title: You own the client, we handle content production and execution
hero.subtitle: Prepay per client and set your own resale price. Try it free on one real client first — a 30-day plan plus 3 images — then keep going if you like it.
hero.sampleCaption: Real sample: Sophie Chen Beauty Studio, a beauty studio in Canada

who.title: Who this is for
who.body1: You already have a handful of local-business clients and want to outsource content production so you can focus on client relationships.
who.body2: You run marketing retainers for businesses and want to add content production and publishing execution.
who.body3: You have clients but no steady shooting/design/scheduling capacity, and want to buy that per client.

division.title: How the work splits
division.body1: Owns the client relationship, collects client info and assets, sets the resale price
division.body2: Provides real product/service facts and assets, confirms the direction
division.body3: Produces the agreed content, adapts it per platform, and handles publishing

deliver.title: What you get
deliver.body1: Produced at the agreed volume — the same image adapted for different platforms doesn't count twice
deliver.body2: Counting and revision rules are still being finalized, and don't follow the image rules
deliver.body3: A month of posting cadence laid out by industry and client info
deliver.body4: Exported per-platform versions, published on the agreed schedule
deliver.body5: A summary of that month's output and publishing

how.title: How it works
how.body1: Fill in the client's basic info, product/service, and assets once
how.body2: Use a private link to see the 30-day plan and 3 trial images
how.body3: If you're happy, prepay per client and scope to start the real engagement
how.body4: Keep submitting assets on an agreed cadence while PoStory keeps producing and publishing

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.body: Priced per client and scope — you set your own resale price. The same image adapted for different platforms counts as one piece of content; a new image is what uses up an allowance.
pricing.example: Example: 3 different images, each adapted for Instagram and Facebook — 6 platform versions total, using only 3 images' worth of allowance.

participate.title: How clients take part
participate.body: You forward the client a private link where they fill in the rest and upload assets. The first trial doesn't require connecting social accounts — that happens once the client moves into the real publishing service.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Always a 30-day marketing plan + 3 images, limited to once per client — you can request it separately for different clients.
faq.q2: Can we trial without complete assets?
faq.a2: Yes — missing assets get a reasonable substitute without slowing things down, and you can add more later.
faq.q3: How long does the trial take?
faq.a3: Timing depends on our production schedule; the private link page keeps the status updated.
faq.a4: During the trial you can give feedback on style and content accuracy; revision rules for the real engagement are agreed when you confirm.
faq.q5: Do we need to connect the client's social accounts?
faq.a5: Not for the trial — that happens once the client moves into the real publishing service.
faq.q6: Do we resubmit info when going paid?
faq.a6: No — the trial info and confirmed style carry straight over, nothing to redo.

closing.title: Submit a client and start your free trial
closing.body: Try it on one real client first — keep going if you like it.

demo.title: From client intake to monthly delivery
demo.subtitle: Follow six steps showing how a partner and client take part. Accounts, publishing statuses, and summary counts are demo data; this walkthrough will not trigger authorization, payment, or real publishing.

intake.title: Submit details
intake.body: The partner gathers client facts, industry, area, goals, and materials. These details inform the marketing plan and content.

plan.title: 30-day plan
plan.body: The plan uses one consistent sample business: Sophie Chen Beauty Studio.

samples.title: Trial samples
samples.body: Review three different original content items. Adapting one image for multiple platforms still counts as one item.

confirm.title: Confirm scope
confirm.body: Before paid work begins, confirm the client, platforms, content allowance, term, and prepayment status. This is a simulated confirmation view.

client.title: Client link
client.body: The partner shares a private link for the client to add details and materials. Social account authorization happens later, before publishing.

summary.title: Delivery summary
summary.body: The partner can review client assignment, platforms, output counts, and delivery status. The sample contains no invented reach or sales results.

values.services: Personalized skincare treatments and professional beauty services
values.audience: Local customers interested in skincare and everyday self-care
values.sampleLink: Demo link (does not open an authorization flow)

demo.planFootnote: This sample month contains {count} content items across a 30-day period. Open the demo calendar to browse them all.
demo.sameContent: This example adapts the same content for Instagram and Facebook.
demo.quotaExample: Allowance example: 3 different images adapted for Instagram and Facebook make 6 platform versions, using only 3 image credits.
demo.noPayment: Browsing this demo will not collect payment, create a paid client account, or change the shared sample data.
demo.noPerformance: These counts summarize demo item statuses only. They do not represent real publishing, reach, engagement, or sales results.
demo.tryOwn: Try it free with your own client →
demo.closingTitle: Want to try it with your own client?
demo.closingBody: After you submit client details, the system will try to generate a 30-day plan from them. The private link keeps the progress and results together.

trial.title: Free trial: 3 sample images
trial.subtitle: Add your client's details and the system will generate a 30-day marketing plan
trial.scopeNote: The trial includes an AI-generated 30-day marketing plan based on client details + 3 images. Platform adaptations don't reduce the 3-image allowance.
trial.agencyContact: Contact (WeChat / email / phone — at least one)
trial.platforms: Platforms to adapt for (select at least one)
trial.referenceFilesHint: Missing assets are fine; up to 5 files, up to 10MB each and 10MB total per upload, png / jpg / webp

errors.fileBatchTooLarge: Uploads must total 10MB or less. Please add files in separate submissions.
errors.fileBadType: Only png / jpg / webp images are supported
errors.duplicateExists: This client already has a trial request in progress — contact us to look it up (for privacy, we don't show the existing link directly here)

view.notFound: We couldn't find this trial request — please check the link
view.missingHint: Missing assets are fine — we'll use a reasonable substitute without delaying delivery
view.planEmpty: In production — will show here once ready
view.planNote: AI generates the plan from the partner's client details. If the generation service is temporarily unavailable, PoStory can retry it.

supplement.title: Add or update client details
supplement.hint: After saving, the system will try to regenerate the 30-day plan from the latest information. Anyone with this private link can add materials and verified business facts.
supplement.platforms: Platforms to adapt for (leave unchecked to keep the current selection)
supplement.updatedWithPlan: Details saved and the 30-day plan updated with the latest information.
supplement.updatedWithoutPlan: Details saved, but AI could not update the plan right now. PoStory can retry from the admin page.

view.assetsEmpty: In production — will show here once ready
view.assetQuotaNote: Each card is one different original image. Platform adaptations belong to that image and don't count again toward the image allowance.
view.convertBody: Once you're happy with the style, contact us to confirm prepayment and carry this trial straight into the real service — no need to fill anything in again.
